title.context: Sheet heading: correct how much of account {name} belongs to each goal.

intro.message: Say how much of the {amount} on this account each goal holds. The balance doesn’t change and nothing moves in the bank: this only corrects which goal the money is for.

shareOf.context: Fix shares sheet: accessible label of a goal's amount field.

over.context: Fix shares sheet: the shares exceed the balance; followed by the amount.

unassigned.context: Fix shares sheet: what stays unassigned; followed by the amount.
